sql.if: AND ( LOWER(reporter_user_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(reason) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(target_summary) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(target_author_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.sql:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rr.id, 'review' AS report_type, rr.review_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, rr.reporter_user_id, rr.reporter_user_name, rr.reason, rr.status, r.region AS region, LEFT(r.content, 120) AS target_summary, r.user_name AS target_author_name, r.user_id AS target_author_id, r.audit_status AS target_audit_status, r.status AS target_status, rr.created_at FROM review_report rr JOIN review r ON r.id = rr.review_id WHERE rr.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.region = #{region} AND r.is_deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT pr.id, 'post' AS report_type, pr.post_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, pr.reporter_user_id, pr.reporter_user_name, pr.reason, pr.status, p.region AS region, LEFT(COALESCE(p.title, p.content), 120) AS target_summary, p.user_name AS target_author_name, p.user_id AS target_author_id, p.audit_status AS target_audit_status, p.status AS target_status, pr.created_at FROM post_report pr JOIN post p ON p.id = pr.post_id WHERE pr.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.region = #{region} AND p.is_deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT mr.id, 'message' AS report_type, mr.target_id AS target_id, mr.target_type AS target_type, mr.reporter_user_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '') AS reporter_user_name, mr.reason, mr.status, 'GLOBAL' AS region, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN LEFT(COALESCE(m.content, ''), 120) ELSE CONCAT('会话 #', mr.target_id) END AS target_summary, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(fu.nickname, '') ELSE '' END AS target_author_name, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN m.from_user_id ELSE 0 END AS target_author_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_audit_status, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_status, mr.created_at FROM message_report mr LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = mr.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN message m ON mr.target_type = 1 AND m.id = mr.target_id LEFT JOIN app_user fu ON fu.id = m.from_user_id WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT rcr.id, 'review_comment' AS report_type, rcr.comment_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, rcr.reporter_user_id, rcr.reporter_user_name, rcr.reason, rcr.status, r.region AS region, LEFT(rc.content, 120) AS target_summary, rc.user_name AS target_author_name, rc.user_id AS target_author_id, rc.status AS target_audit_status, CASE WHEN rc.is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS target_status, rcr.created_at FROM review_comment_report rcr JOIN review_comment rc ON rc.id = rcr.comment_id JOIN review r ON r.id = rc.review_id WHERE rcr.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.region = #{region} AND rc.is_deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT pcr.id, 'post_comment' AS report_type, pcr.comment_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, pcr.reporter_user_id, pcr.reporter_user_name, pcr.reason, pcr.status, p.region AS region, LEFT(pc.content, 120) AS target_summary, pc.user_name AS target_author_name, pc.user_id AS target_author_id, pc.status AS target_audit_status, CASE WHEN pc.is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS target_status, pcr.created_at FROM post_comment_report pcr JOIN post_comment pc ON pc.id = pcr.comment_id JOIN post p ON p.id = pc.post_id WHERE pcr.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.region = #{region} AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE ) reports WHERE 1 = 1
AND report_type = #{reportType}
AND status = #{status}
mapper.select: ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT mr.id, 'message' AS report_type, mr.target_id AS target_id, mr.target_type AS target_type, mr.reporter_user_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '') AS reporter_user_name, mr.reason, mr.status, 'GLOBAL' AS region, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN LEFT(COALESCE(m.content, ''), 120) ELSE CONCAT('会话 #', mr.target_id) END AS target_summary, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(fu.nickname, '') ELSE '' END AS target_author_name, CASE WHEN mr.target_type = 1 THEN m.from_user_id ELSE 0 END AS target_author_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_audit_status, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_status, mr.created_at FROM message_report mr LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = mr.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN message m ON mr.target_type = 1 AND m.id = mr.target_id LEFT JOIN app_user fu ON fu.id = m.from_user_id WHERE mr.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT rcr.id, 'review_comment' AS report_type, rcr.comment_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, rcr.reporter_user_id, rcr.reporter_user_name, rcr.reason, rcr.status, r.region AS region, LEFT(rc.content, 120) AS target_summary, rc.user_name AS target_author_name, rc.user_id AS target_author_id, rc.status AS target_audit_status, CASE WHEN rc.is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS target_status, rcr.created_at FROM review_comment_report rcr JOIN review_comment rc ON rc.id = rcr.comment_id JOIN review r ON r.id = rc.review_id WHERE rcr.id = #{id} AND rcr.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.region = #{region} AND rc.is_deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

SELECT pcr.id, 'post_comment' AS report_type, pcr.comment_id AS target_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS target_type, pcr.reporter_user_id, pcr.reporter_user_name, pcr.reason, pcr.status, p.region AS region, LEFT(pc.content, 120) AS target_summary, pc.user_name AS target_author_name, pc.user_id AS target_author_id, pc.status AS target_audit_status, CASE WHEN pc.is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS target_status, pcr.created_at FROM post_comment_report pcr JOIN post_comment pc ON pc.id = pcr.comment_id JOIN post p ON p.id = pc.post_id WHERE pcr.id = #{id} AND pcr.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.region = #{region} AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE review_report SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE post_report SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE review SET audit_status = 2, audit_remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND region = #{region} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE post SET audit_status = 2, audit_remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{postId} AND region = #{region} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE review_report SET status = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE post_report SET status = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE review_comment_report SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE post_comment_report SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE

UPDATE review_comment SET status = 2, audit_remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE (id = #{commentId} OR parent_id = #{commentId}) AND is_deleted = FALSE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.id = review_comment.review_id AND r.region = #{region} )

UPDATE post_comment SET status = 2, audit_remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE (id = #{commentId} OR parent_id = #{commentId}) AND is_deleted = FALSE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post p WHERE p.id = post_comment.post_id AND p.region = #{region} )

UPDATE review_comment_report SET status = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id IN ( SELECT id FROM review_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} OR parent_id = #{commentId} ) AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE

UPDATE post_comment_report SET status = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id IN ( SELECT id FROM post_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} OR parent_id = #{commentId} ) AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE
